The **Prime Minister** leads the government and lives at **10 Downing Street**. The Cabinet includes the Chancellor of the Exchequer (economy), the Home Secretary and the Foreign Secretary.

The second-largest party is the **opposition**. Civil servants carry out policy and are politically neutral. **Hansard** is the record of what is said in Parliament.

The Scottish Parliament meets at **Holyrood** in Edinburgh, the Welsh Parliament (Senedd) in Cardiff Bay, and the Northern Ireland Assembly at **Stormont** in Belfast.
